formDescription: Identity/profile step for personal-information requests. Collects the applicant's legal name and (for some request topics) date of birth. When the applicant is authenticated via BC Services Card, first/last name are pre-filled and locked (shown read-only, sourced from the card) and the applicant only fills in the remaining fields.

first_name.title: First name / Given names
first_name.description: Applicant's legal first name. Pre-filled and disabled when authenticated via BC Services Card.

middle_name.title: Middle name
middle_name.description: Applicant's legal middle name, if any. Only shown when not authenticated via BC Services Card.

last_name.title: Last name
last_name.description: Applicant's legal last name. Pre-filled and disabled when authenticated via BC Services Card.

also_known_as.title: Also known as
also_known_as.description: Any other name(s) the applicant is or was known by.

birth_date.title: Birth Date
birth_date.description: Applicant's date of birth. Only shown/required for certain request topics (e.g. personal information requests where the ministry needs it to verify identity). Must not be a future date.

business_name.title: Business/Organization name
business_name.description: If applicable, the business or organization the applicant represents. Law firms should identify whether they represent the client in this request or someone else, and include a file number where possible.

notes: birth_date's required/visible state is toggled at runtime via route data (includeBirthDate) rather than being static per-route.
